description: Receipt emitted by anchor-cron after it writes a completed esign envelope's hash to Base L2 (and, when `councilMirror` is true on the source envelope, also to the geth-private constitutional chain). Establishes the third (and optional fourth) layer of the 4-layer substrate per ADR-2605192245 / ADR-2605231230.

envelopeUri.description: AT URI of the envelope that was anchored.

completedEventUri.description: AT URI of the `completedEvent` that triggered anchoring.

documentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the document committed on-chain (copied for indexer convenience).

baseAnchor.description: Anchor receipt on Base L2 (mainnet or Sepolia testnet during phase 2).

councilMirrorAnchor.description: Mirror anchor on the geth-private constitutional chain. Present iff the source envelope had `councilMirror=true`.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain ID. Base mainnet = 8453, Base Sepolia = 84532, geth-private constitutional = 91101 (per ADR-2605192245).

contractAddress.description: Lowercase hex-encoded 20-byte contract address that holds the anchor (`EsignAnchor.sol` or equivalent). Prefix `0x`.

blockNumber.description: Block number containing the anchoring transaction.
